profile_text.body:
AI Now Institute is a nonprofit founded in 2017 and headquartered in New York, NY. On its website, the institute describes itself as challenging and reimagining the current trajectory for AI. Its latest annual report maps the current state of play with the AI market, interrogates the industry's key sources of power, and provides an actionable strategy to reclaim public agency over the future of AI. The institute's website argues for clarity about actual risks as concern about AI capabilities turns toward regulating companies.

The institute does not list any products. Its staff include Sarah Myers West, co-executive director, and Heidy Khlaaf, chief AI scientist and a former OpenAI safety engineer. Khlaaf pushes for evidence and concrete examples that can verify AI safety claims, stating that scientific claims require falsifiability. West joined Maggie McGrath to discuss whether agentic supreme intelligence is possible, the responsibility companies have in developing AI tools, and what politicians need to do to get up to speed on the technology.

The institute has no litigation cases and no MCP servers listed. It has a New York law exposure count of 448.
